1.1.0: Change file select input of DownloadFile to avoid loading all files when selecting a file.
1.1.1: Update DownloadFile file input label and tooltip.
1.1.2: Authentication module made compatible with Appmixer 5.0
1.3.0: NewFile, NewFolder: add Path and Recursive options.
1.3.3: Added output examples to component schemas.
1.4.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewFile, NewFolder.
1.5.1: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Dropbox API.
1.7.0: Output ports of CreateFolder, CreateTextFile, DownloadFile, FindFiles, FindFolders, GetFileMetadata, NewFile, NewFolder, RenameFile, SaveURL and UploadFile migrated from the legacy `options[]` form to a typed JSON `schema` with an example on every leaf, so the variable picker shows types and previews. Field names and emitted data are unchanged.
Added missing required-input validation (`CancelError`) to CreateFolder, CreateTextFile, DownloadFile, FindFiles, FindFolders, GetFileMetadata, RenameFile, SaveURL and UploadFile.
ListFiles: added `ignoreAuth=true` to the dynamic output-port source so the designer variables fetch stops requiring an account.
2.0.0: (breaking change) FindFiles and FindFolders now follow the Find component standard: the per-item output ports `file` and `folder` are replaced by a single dynamic `out` port plus a `notFound` port, and a new `Output Type` input selects how the result set is delivered (first item / all at once / one at a time / CSV file). Existing flows wired to the `file` or `folder` port must be reconnected to `out` and their variable references updated.
FindFiles, FindFolders: added the shared outputType helpers (new `lib.js`) and an exported `ITEM_SCHEMA`, so the variable picker shows typed fields with examples.
ListFiles: the dynamic output-port source no longer maps the required `path` input from a flow value — schema generation sends a literal instead, so the variable picker stops degrading to Raw Output.
